clue.text: Energetic person wants motor racing to update for new image

parts.note: Formula One, written F1, is read as the letters FI
to rebrand is to relaunch with a fresh corporate identity

explanation.surface: A dynamic go-getter wants Formula One to freshen up its public image.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1 of F1 is taken as the letter I, a common crossword trick.
explanation.definitionFit: A firebrand is a passionate, forceful agitator, so an energetic, fiery person fits.

clue.text: Notes accommodation units — area likely to be flooded?

definitions.meaning: musical notes lowered a semitone, like B-flat
apartments on one floor of a building
low-lying land such as mudflats, covered at high tide

explanation.surface: Jottings about housing blocks in a flood-prone district.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers flattened musical notes, apartments, and level low-lying ground by water.

clue.text: Roar after game and escape quickly

indicators.note: after places the word for roar following the game

parts.note: RU is Rugby Union
to roar is to shout

explanation.surface: Bellowing after the match and making a quick getaway.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush out is to leave a place in a hurry, a phrasal verb for escape.

clue.text: Cockney in smashing deal? It shows the pressure one's under

definitions.text: It shows the pressure one's under

indicators.note: smashing into the word for deal puts the Cockney piece inside it

parts.note: to barter is to trade, to deal
being in is being at home, and a Cockney drops the H of home

explanation.surface: A Londoner caught up in a great bargain feels the strain.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney is the London East End accent, which drops initial H.
explanation.definitionFit: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure, the air pressure we all live under.

clue.text: Irish can act riotously, wanting no form of government

indicators.note: acting riotously is acting wildly, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Irish folk can behave wildly, rejecting any authority.
explanation.definitionFit: Anarchism opposes all government, so an anarchistic view rejects rule entirely.

clue.text: Pal to arise, becoming knight

indicators.note: in a down entry, arising means reading upwards, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: bud, short for buddy, is a pal

explanation.surface: A friend is told to rise, having been made a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arise, Sir...' is what the monarch says when knighting someone, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To dub is to confer a knighthood with a touch of the sword, so knight as a verb.

clue.text: Put under joint ownership? A rejected suggestion

indicators.note: the A in the clue is thrown out of the longer word, so rejected signals removal

parts.note: property owned jointly is shared

explanation.surface: Someone's proposal to share ownership of something is turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: A shred, as in 'a shred of evidence', is a tiny trace or hint, much like a suggestion.

clue.text: Maestro in GB possibly

parts.note: in tonic sol-fa in C major, sol is the note G and ti is B, so the two syllables can stand for G and B

explanation.surface: A great conductor working in Britain, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: GB looks like Great Britain; it is two notes of the scale.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Georg Solti was a celebrated Hungarian-British conductor, a maestro.

clue.text: Socialists admitting fighting to get payments deserved?

indicators.note: admitting means letting the word for fighting in

parts.note: Reds is a common name for socialists or communists
war is fighting

explanation.surface: Left-wingers admit to a struggle to earn the pay they deserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Rewards are sums given in return for merit, so earned payments.

clue.text: Fights — what can stop them for a while?

definitions.text: what can stop them for a while?
definitions.meaning: the bell rung to end each round of a boxing bout

explanation.definitionFit: A ding-dong is a heated fight, and also the sound of the bell that halts boxing between rounds.

clue.text: Adult taking short journey into America or European country

parts.note: A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult

indicators.note: into tells us the shortened journey goes inside the word for America

parts.note: USA is America

indicators.note: short means the last letter of the word for journey is cut off

parts.note: a trip is a journey

explanation.surface: A grown-up takes a quick trip to the USA or somewhere in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Austria is a landlocked nation in central Europe, capital Vienna.

clue.text: Obvious gain for Tory PM

parts.note: a bald statement is plain and obvious
to win is to gain

explanation.surface: A clear advantage for a Conservative prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: Stanley Baldwin was a Conservative ('Tory') British prime minister three times between the wars.
explanation.definitionFit: Stanley Baldwin led Conservative governments in the 1920s and 1930s, an instance of the definition.

clue.text: Maiden goes off, retreating in rage

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
food that goes off rots

explanation.surface: A young woman storms out, backing away in fury.
explanation.definitionFit: To storm is to rage furiously, and a storm of anger is an outburst of rage.

clue.text: Got rid of money and identity before getting caught

parts.note: cash is money

indicators.note: the word for before is caught, or held, between the letters of identity

parts.note: ID is short for identity
ere is a poetic word for before

explanation.surface: Someone ditched their cash and ID papers just before being arrested.
explanation.definitionFit: To cashier an officer is to dismiss them from the armed forces in disgrace, so to get rid of them.

clue.text: March beginning to provide opportunity for celebration

definitions.text: March beginning to provide opportunity for celebration

parts.words: March beginning to provide opportunity for celebration
parts.note: the feast of Wales's patron saint falls on 1 March, the very start of the month

explanation.walkthrough: 'March' looks like a verb about a parade; it is the month.
explanation.definitionFit: Wales celebrates its patron saint every 1 March with daffodils and leeks.

clue.text: One using ultrasound for detecting speed

definitions.meaning: the flying mammal that finds prey by echolocation
an old informal word for pace, as in 'going at a fair lick'

explanation.definitionFit: Bats echolocate with high-pitched calls; 'at a rare bat' is a dated idiom for at great speed.

clue.text: After short moment of hesitation two daughters had opportunity for romance

indicators.note: short means the last letter is lopped off

parts.note: a blink is a brief pause or moment
D is daughter, so two of them give DD
had, as in had a meal, means ate

explanation.surface: After a brief pause, two girls got a chance at love.
explanation.definitionFit: A blind date is a romantic meeting between strangers, a chance at love.

clue.text: Maybe they have shaken north's pride

indicators.note: something shaken has its contents jumbled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Perhaps some people have had the north's pride knocked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe' shows the definition is by example: 'they' is a pronoun of the grammatical category named.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar, they, he, she and it are pronouns of the third person, so 'they' is an example.

clue.text: Former Welsh rite given a new twist

indicators.note: twisting the letters into a new order signals rearrangement

explanation.surface: An old Welsh ceremony is reinvented.
explanation.definitionFit: Erstwhile is a literary adjective for former or one-time.

clue.text: Orders yours truly's presented to workers without love

parts.note: yours truly is the speaker, so 'yours truly is' gives I'M

indicators.note: without means the letter for love is left out

parts.note: operatives are workers
love is zero in tennis, giving the letter O

explanation.surface: Commands I've handed to the staff without any affection.
explanation.definitionFit: Imperatives are commands that must be obeyed, so orders.

clue.text: Runner bumping into rival — what could be more annoying?

indicators.note: bumping into means the runner word goes inside the rival word

parts.note: a peer is an equal, someone who rivals you
a ski is a runner on a sledge or snow vehicle

explanation.surface: An athlete collides with a competitor: what could be worse?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runner' looks like an athlete; it is a ski.
explanation.definitionFit: Pesky means irritating, and its comparative means more irritating.

clue.text: Vehicle has problem with no engineers available

indicators.note: with no means the letters for engineers are removed

parts.note: a rebus is a picture puzzle, so a problem to solve
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: A broken-down vehicle has a fault and no mechanics are free.
explanation.definitionFit: A bus is a large road vehicle carrying passengers.

clue.text: Baby with absent father flags maybe

definitions.meaning: the nursery rhyme 'Bye, baby ___, Daddy's gone a-hunting'

explanation.surface: A baby whose dad is away, perhaps waving flags.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense comes from the English lullaby 'Bye, baby bunting, Daddy's gone a-hunting'.
explanation.definitionFit: Bunting is festive decoration of small flags, and the baby in the lullaby whose daddy has gone hunting.

clue.text: Is prayer held by theologian to be badly out of favour?

indicators.note: held by means the other pieces sit inside the theologian's letters

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree
grace is a prayer said before a meal

explanation.surface: A divine wonders whether a prayer will make someone fall from grace.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone disgraced has lost all respect and standing, so is badly out of favour.

clue.text: Cheat needing form of therapy — one is devoid of feelings

parts.note: to rob someone is to cheat them
OT is occupational therapy

explanation.surface: A con man needs treatment since he is emotionless.
explanation.definitionFit: A robot is a machine, so it has no emotions.

clue.text: Silver currently making comeback, making dosh

indicators.note: a comeback is a return, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
now means currently

explanation.surface: Silver is enjoying a revival and earning people money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wonga' and 'dosh' are both British slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are informal British slang for cash, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Look at account that's initially given after a 1965 crisis

indicators.note: given after places the picked letter after the other pieces

parts.note: UDI, Rhodesia's Unilateral Declaration of Independence from Britain in 1965

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: An inquiry examines the books following a political upheaval in the 1960s.
explanation.definitionFit: An audit is an official inspection of financial accounts.

clue.text: "Yes, I am competent" is answer to this? That's pleasing

parts.words: "Yes, I am competent" is answer to this?
parts.note: split into three words, the solution makes a question whose natural reply is 'Yes, I am competent'

explanation.surface: Someone affirms their own competence, which is a nice thing to hear.
explanation.definitionFit: Amiable means friendly and good-natured, so agreeable or pleasing.

clue.text: Trouble-maker turning up in row I avoided

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up means reading from bottom to top
avoided means the letter I is left out

parts.note: a file is a row or line

explanation.surface: A mischief-maker appears in a quarrel that I steered clear of.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel; it is a line.
explanation.definitionFit: Elves in folklore are mischievous imps who cause trouble.

clue.text: Performance involving Roman couple in which female is greatly exalted

indicators.note: involving means taking the other pieces inside

parts.note: a deed is an act or performance

indicators.note: in which says the female letter sits within the Roman pair

parts.note: II is two in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A show featuring two Romans in which a woman is held in high esteem.
explanation.definitionFit: To deify is to make a god of, the ultimate exaltation.

clue.text: Bird in sorrow hiding head

indicators.note: hiding its head means the first letter is concealed and dropped

parts.note: regret is sorrow

explanation.surface: A bird in mourning conceals its head.
explanation.definitionFit: An egret is a white wading heron.

clue.text: Boxer you observed during air journey cuddling wife

indicators.note: during means the next pieces go inside the word for the air journey

parts.note: a flight is a journey by air

indicators.note: cuddling means wrapping the old form of you around the wife letter

parts.note: ye is an old form of you

explanation.surface: A boxer was seen on a plane hugging his wife.
explanation.definitionFit: A flyweight is a boxer in the lightest standard weight class.
